_comment: #438 [Deathknight] -- warrior x necromancer, end to end, automatic (#472). THE CAP IS THE SUBJECT: [Necromancer]'s own level table stops at 12 with no evolution, so before this row the class simply ended; the merge is the only rung above it, and even the cheapest legal pair clears the ceiling by two. Fixture near_deathknight_consolidation: warrior 11 + necromancer 10, merging to max(ceil(2*21/3), max(11,10)) == 14. THE ROW THIS SCRIPT GATES is the ORDER of classes.json's `consolidations[]`: the deathknight row sits ABOVE [Spellsword]'s, which shares its `[warrior]` line, so this script reds on `target: deathknight` if that placement is ever reversed AND the spellsword row is ever re-widened past its narrowed pair. THE OPAQUE-UNTIL-SLEEP LOCK is proved before the bed rather than asserted in prose. The closing fight is the kit proof, read with the starter sword WORN: `WICombatBuild.weapon_gated_kit` strips weapon-mismatched Skills, and [Grave Edge] is sword-gated exactly like the [Keener Edge] it re-flavors.

steps._comment: The pair, held. [Warrior] is UNEVOLVED here -- no dominance was banked, which is what leaves the base martial line free to take the necromancer merge.

THE OPAQUE-UNTIL-SLEEP LOCK, proved rather than asserted in prose. This save stands ON the threshold: both parents clear min_parent_level and their sum is exactly min_combined_level. If eligibility resolved anywhere before the sleep beat, the merge event would already be in this run's stream -- and it is not.
The fixture stands at your_bed facing it, so the beat is one interact away; the inn walk is consolidation_flow's subject, not this script's.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: THE ROW #438 EXISTS FOR. beast_master + mage resolves to wild_sage, never druid -- and to the SAME derived floor, since the merge formula never looked at which lineage the parents were.
#472: consolidation is AUTOMATIC. There is no prompt to answer, so the absence of an offer event is part of the contract rather than an accident of this fixture.

lines:1 = the single merge-announce line. This fixture sits exactly at the threshold and banks no class or level announcements, so a second line here would mean progress text leaked into the veil -- the opaque-until-sleep product lock, read where a player actually reads it.

THE PLAYER-FACING COPY, pinned rather than waved through with a bare toast wait: canon bracket voice, both retiring parents named, the new class named, and NOTHING else -- no merged-level number, no counter, no stat grammar.

THE JOURNAL HALF. The merge toast carries lore:true, so the same sentence is banked to the durable Lore record -- a class the player never chose to lose can be read back at leisure instead of living or dying by one toast's render race.
To the goblin camp: teleport to the lane above goblin_encounter_1 (30,23) and step into its radius-2 trigger, the same beat druid_consolidation_loop fights.

THE KIT PROOF, all three halves. greater_strength is [Warrior]'s own L7 grant reaching the merged class through `inherits`. grave_edge is [Deathknight]'s OWN L14 grant, the death-flavored twin of [Spellsword]'s [Keener Edge], and it is only in this list because the fixture wears a sword. deathbolt is [Necromancer]'s L3 grant -- the half that had nowhere left to climb before this row existed -- so both parent lines are shown surviving the merge.
